SceneConfig.Heading: Isometric
SceneConfig.EnableHint: Apply dimetric 2:1 isometric projection to this scene and its grid.
SceneConfig.TransformBackgroundHint: Also apply the isometric projection to the scene background image. When unchecked (default), the background appears undistorted.
SceneConfig.ProjectionHint: Isometric projection style. Switch to Custom to enter exact rotation/skew/ratio values.

TokenConfig.Heading: Isometric
TokenConfig.TransformTokenHint: Apply the isometric stage transform to this token. When unchecked (default), the token sprite appears undistorted regardless of stage rotation.
TokenConfig.ShowImageManipulationHint: Show the image offset/scale handles (white circle and square) and the dashed image contour when the token is selected.
TokenConfig.ShowVolumeManipulationHint: Show the 3D bounding box and the elevation handle when the token is selected.

TileConfig.Heading: Isometric
TileConfig.TransformTileHint: Apply the isometric stage transform to this tile. When unchecked (default), the tile sprite appears undistorted regardless of stage rotation.
TileConfig.ShowImageManipulationHint: Show the image offset/scale handles (white circle and square) and the dashed image contour when the tile is selected.
TileConfig.ShowVolumeManipulationHint: Show the 3D bounding box and all volume handles (size, elevation, move) when the tile is selected.

DefaultTokenHeight.Name: Default Token Height
DefaultTokenHeight.Hint: Default bounding box height (in grid units) for tokens without an explicit height flag.

OcclusionOpacity.Name: Occlusion Opacity
OcclusionOpacity.Hint: Alpha value for tokens occluded behind a tile volume (0 = invisible, 1 = no effect).
